findings: Relative qualifying clauses precede their head.
The relative verb agrees with its own clause subject when that differs from the head.
Present adjectival quality in a subordinate clause can use the appropriate form of honä.
items.supports: Productive clause order and plural-corners agreement in the proposed generic singular-shape label.
